summary: Frontend-only dark mode / theme toggle regression testing completed. Toggle button (data-testid=theme-toggle-button) is visible on Login page (top-right) and on every AppShell topbar. Clicking toggles `dark` class on <html>, icon flips (Moon↔Sun), and preference is persisted to localStorage key `ls_theme`. Verified persistence across page reloads, across navigation, and across logout→login (unlike sessionStorage-based auth). Navigated all 7 authenticated pages in dark mode: Dashboard, Pemantauan Stok, Master Reagen, Data LIS, PRF, Penerimaan, Analisis Struktur Excel, Kelola Pengguna — all render correctly with `dark` class active. Dashboard hero 'Selamat datang di LabStock' banner is clearly readable in dark mode (computed color rgb(230,235,240) on dark gradient). Pemantauan Stok table headers, saldo awal column, today's date highlight, and status side-bars all readable. Tambah Akun dialog (Kelola Pengguna) also renders with dark bg (rgb(11,17,30)) and light text — shadcn CSS variables propagate correctly. Toggle works for both raihan (koordinator) and kalgen (petugas) — not role-restricted. Light mode Dashboard is unchanged (no regression).
critical_code_review_comments: theme.js: getInitialTheme uses `window.matchMedia` without SSR guard — fine for CRA/browser-only React, no action needed.
ThemeProvider correctly placed outermost (before AuthProvider) in App.js so Login screen also gets theme + toggle.
Toggle uses shadcn Button ghost variant — clean, accessible, has title attribute for tooltip in Bahasa Indonesia.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark mode fully verified across all pages, dialogs, and both roles. Persistence via localStorage key `ls_theme` works across reload + logout. Screenshots captured: dashboard_light, dashboard_dark, pemantauan_dark, pengguna_dark, dialog_dark — all visually clean, good contrast in dark mode. No regressions in light mode. No backend changes needed.
